doctrine: Authority, cognition, and effect planes are type-distinct: values never convert without explicit boundary types, and cognition output can never grant effect authority.

ambiguous.definition: Types that bridge multiple planes or combine source evidence with derived hypotheses; reported as findings without guessing

authority.definition: Immutable observations, identities, policies, receipts, capability tokens, and canonical state
authority.mutation_rule: Authority may only be updated via verified cryptographic receipts or canonical ledger transitions

cognition.definition: Tracks, embeddings, hypotheses, rankings, model outputs, beliefs, and memories
cognition.mutation_rule: Cognition may propose but cannot directly mutate authority or perform effects

effect.definition: Alerts, PTZ, retention, export, deletion, activation, and repair mutations
effect.mutation_rule: Effects require prepared intent, capability, precondition, idempotency identity, and receipt

support.definition: Typed error structures, parser helpers, and foundational codec utilities

AlertEffectRecord.ambiguity_reason: Audited boundary record coupling cognition event revision digest with effect operation ID and terminal state

SupervisionAdvance.description: Exact next-prefix transition bound to the prior scheduled state, ACKed or discarded delivery and current anchor; idempotent latest retry preserves a successor without refunding charged work.

PendingSupervisionDelivery.description: Private historical report, complete source inventory, original authority and original optional window prefix bound to one exact delivery receipt; public inspection exposes descriptors only.

SupervisionSubscription.description: Recovered finite supervision progress with immutable scope, optional cumulative schedule, nonrefillable attempts, private pending delivery and exact ACK/discard identities.

SupervisionAction.description: One explicit inspection, schedule configuration, next-window advance, poll, exact acknowledgement or discard; no implicit successor evaluation or effect execution.

SupervisionSessionRequest.description: Immutable registration and caller-supplied current authority root for one finite session operation.

SupervisionRecoveryRequest.description: Existing session and subscription selected under explicit current authority to recover exact immutable configuration and lifetime ceilings; no source or effect authority.

SupervisionRecoveryBinding.description: Exact borrowed recovery request, authenticated principal, deployment namespace and bounded history limits presented to caller-owned admission at each boundary.

SupervisionRecoveryBoundary.description: Explicit admission points for history, journal, live registration lookup, current-history revalidation and exact configuration delivery; no native attempt or pending payload release.

SupervisionSessionBinding.description: Borrowed exact request, principal, deployment namespace, durable active prefix and history ceilings presented to explicit operation admission.

SupervisionSessionBoundary.description: Named admission points for history, journal, reservation, native work, current revalidation and complete output.

SupervisionAdapterError.description: Native source-owner or runtime refusal retaining its stable diagnostic without exposing a partial payload.

SupervisionEvaluation.description: Complete fresh native computation and complete original source inventory awaiting durable pending publication.

SupervisionValidation.description: Separate current native validation of an exact historical inventory with bounded measured source costs; no new complete-catalog or absence claim.

SupervisionSessionHead.description: Exact observed canonical anchor, ledger/effect journal roots and existing evidence-clock watermark; observation grants no effects.

SupervisionSessionOutcome.description: One historical descriptor inspection, schedule configuration, explicit advance, complete report, exact ACK or discard result; original and current source authority remain distinct.

SupervisionSessionDelivery.description: Complete admitted outcome with live session, current history, durable subscription state and pinned journal root.

SupervisionSessionError.description: Typed admission, session, CAS, source or authority refusal.

SupervisionSessionFailure.description: Refusal with definitely committed schedule, reservation, advancement and ACK/discard progress; never claims rollback or emits successful report bytes.

PullPointError.description: Typed native acquisition refusal with bounded, payload-free diagnostic identity.

PullPointAcquisition.description: Immutable owner acquisition witness binding approval, exact route and control-source hashes, request identities and ordered monotonic intervals; no authenticated server or profile-filter claim.

ReplayAdmission.description: Borrowed live native owner admission at replay and publication checkpoints; only narrows existing I/O authority and cannot outlive its request.

ReplayAdmissionError.description: Sticky typed owner cancellation, deadline, authority, budget, reentrancy or unwind refusal; never implies rollback of earlier durable work.

UnsubscribeBinding.description: Independently owner-declared cleanup route, approval, request identity and receive interval; historical endpoint custody cannot substitute for current authority.

RetainedUnsubscribe.description: Historical successful cleanup response linked to exact Create custody; require_relates_to enforces explicit reply correlation without guaranteeing future device behavior or granting effects.

RenewIntentBinding.description: Original scoped route, approval, fresh request identity, admission time, finite lifetime and bounded attempt index for a Renew request; retained provenance cannot grant fresh dispatch authority.

RenewOutcomeBinding.description: Complete HTTP-response observations with explicit optional monotonic completion, client-Digest status and SOAP content type; no implied successful lease extension.

RetainedRenewIntent.description: Verified pre-dispatch Renew intent with exact original Create closure; dispatch and result remain unknown without a response, and cold opens or exact storage retries never authorize redispatch.

RetainedRenewal.description: Complete historical Renew response custody, including unusable replies, with optional strictly correlated lease interpretation; does not authenticate the camera, prove current state or grant renewal authority.

RetainedProgress.description: Known durable batch or control receipt plus an optional refusal of further work; late cancellation preserves committed custody without granting cleanup or polling authority.

PullPointControl.description: Audited retention boundary for owner-declared Create/Renew intents and private Create/Renew/Unsubscribe observations; callbacks must establish custody before progress, and payloads grant no I/O authority.
